name: vibe-ledger
description: Explain an AI-built app to the person who made it and check it: a map of the project's parts and the data between them (open a part into its files), every request from the Claude Code / Codex conversations checked against the code (done, partly, not done, done differently, superseded), and a safety ledger of what was promised and put off — each verdict backed by evidence a script verifies. One offline HTML page. Local only.
